$comment: Mirror of sprk_analysisaction.sprk_inputschema for list-tasks (spaarkeai-assistant-enhancements-r1 task 050). Normalized OpenAI-function-parameters subset (validated by CatalogInputSchemaContractTests + jps-validate). The user's utterance is the only input; the tasks themselves are queried client-side by the DataGrid framework (ownerid eq-userid), never a maker-provided or LLM-authored value. Property-level "required": true is FORBIDDEN (invalid JSON Schema — use the object-level required array). No actionId here — it is assigned in Dataverse at deploy time. actionCode carries NO version suffix (owner hygiene).

request.description: The user's request to see their tasks, in their own words (e.g. 'what are my tasks', 'show my open tasks'). The agent loop supplies this from the user's message.
